text:
Been coming to the Andaman clinic for about 5 years now

The doctor here is incredibly knowledgeable and speaks excellent English and always very clear on what the problem is.

I've maybe used the clinic 5+ times during this period including a very minor skin procedure with stitches.

Every time I've been, I've always felt better quickly and received the correct treatment.

Would definitely highly  recommend

Thought I had some cotton from a cotton swab in my ear. The doctor checked and there was nothing, he said it was a little inflammation because I had poked the cotton swab too deep. Then he wanted to rinse my ear, he flushed some water in my ear for two minutes and wanted 1500 baht for it! He also wanted to sell me ear drops and antibiotics. Antibiotics for inflammation! Are you kidding? The doctor was also a little sick, he snorted like he had a cold but he didn't have a face mask so I'll probably catch a cold from him, Thanks for that... and 1500 baht for two minutes of work.... Hmm.....
The best clinic in Rawai. This doctors are very well educated and have manu years of professional experience. One kf the first and best respected clinics in Rawai. Honest and honorable.

The doctor was an absolute professional using laser to cut out some lipomas I had, the staff were amazing and super kind and helpful. Both Noi and Oh were the sweetest and always checked up and me to make the experience super special!

I had some skin lesions removed by laser here. The staff are helpful, courteous, knowledgeable and speak excellent English. The work was done quickly and efficiently, and I felt confident that the treatment was effective.

Unfortunately some of the other reviews about incorrect prescriptions are correct.

I give an extra star because he correctly identified my infection and gave me the correct antibiotics, but over sold and over prescribed me, either for profit or through lack of knowledge.

He sold me 4 injectable antibiotics, 1 each day, then start the oral antibiotics after that.

When I saw a specialist on the third day of injections, I was told the correct dose is 1 injection, not 4, and the oral antibiotics should be started straight away.

So not only did I waste time and money, I also delayed getting better by not taking oral antibiotics and had a very bad time as the infection got worse.
I went to get my medical certificate for renewing my driver's license. It was very cheap, quick, and convenient. The two nurses who assisted me were sweet. I was there for less than 5 minutes.

Getting pneumonia in Thailand is very dangerous.

When I stumbled into Andaman Healthcare Clinic in Rawai, I could barely walk to the back rooms for treatment.

Dr. Sakda quickly diagnosed my condition and recognised it was pneumonia.

He immediately gave me the right injections and put me on a three-day course that helped me recover quickly.

While it still takes time to fully heal from this kind of illness, I’m incredibly grateful that Dr. Sakda and his team were there when I needed them.

Thank you so much.

Brilliant doctor.  Great staff.  I had a heat rash on my side and back,  that just wouldn't go away.
The doctor explained how humidity prevents the pores from breathing and fixed the problem.  Antibiotics, medical soap, loose light clothing - completely clear.  Thank you!

Beware: this "doctor" does not match basic standard of ability, communication and respect for patients.
He performed a show for me to look like he investigates, then tried to force me to an antibiotic injection and followup antibiotic treatment without any confirming symptoms of bacterial/pathogen infection. I explained why it does not make any sense and rejected it.
Then he used well known scam tactics of creating fear by claiming that going to a hospital would be very expensive etc., but after seeing that it will not persuade me to pay more to him, he left without giving any further advice or help.
Also the lady working for him is not a certified nurse, just a useful idiot to help with this fraud.
Update: I now have confirmation that his diagnosis was completely wrong.

The service from andaman clinic is outstanding. Doctor sakda ruamrungsee and his lovely wife are doing their best to help us all. Yesterday I broad a friend from Switzerland having some problems with his feet there, and the doctor came right away from his home to give a hand.
Much appreciated his actions and we are all happy now.
Even myself been there for many years for different services and everytime I could feel the kindness of the hole team.
I can highly recommend andaman clinic at all times.

Captain
Domiinic doerig

A small but professional clinic conveniently located on the main road next to the Aussie bar in Rawai. I was seen immediately by the very friendly, English speaking nurse who passed me over to speak to the doctor after asking some relevant and intelligent questions. The doctor was very knowledgeable and provided an immediate course of treatment. My follow-up appointment needed further attention but they only charged me for the medicine. This clinic is the perfect option for common medical requirements and is much cheaper than private hospitals that are located much further away.

What a lovely Doctor and he knows what he is doing. Not like in some of the better hospitals here where they put you in hospital for 3 days no matter what’s wrong ... as long as you have insurance.
I had stomach cramps. He checked me out thoroughly. Gave me an injection and pills. More importantly he explained the problem.
Highly recommend him if you are staying in the south of Phuket

They took my blood sample before taking my blood pressure, which of course made it spike. Then my "consultation" with the doctor which lasted all of 10 minutes that explained nothing about my results, or even what each of the metrics means. When I asked him to recommend ways to bring my triglyercides down he told TO GOOGLE IT. Yep.

So I ended up googling each of the the abbreviations and numbers to figure out the results,after I had to contact to please send my results because a month later they still didn't send them to me.

They did not print out the results for me, and failed to email them to me as promised. It was a complete waste of money, no matter how reasonably priced.

I would definitely go to a real hospital next time.

Andaman Clinic is an excellent facility,  Dr Sakda is a very pleasant caring man, he is thorough in his examination,  informative with his diagnosis.  I had the misfortune of becoming dehydrated and both the nurse and doctor were outstanding and soon had me back in my feet. Definitely a far better option for non critical medical requirements than the international hospitals.

Better to visit a proper hospital, this clinic does not have an analysis laboratory, even though they offer testing. And the doctor over doses his patients with antibiotics, which is very dangerous for the patient. I got told i would need 1000mg of antibiotics via IV for 5 days, plus 2 weeks of antibiotics pills after that, all to treat a bacterial infection the doctor had no clue what the infection was, or how severe, but worked on pure guesswork in terms of severity. I urge people to visit a proper clinic in Phuket town rather than go to this clinic which is proper dodgy

I have visited Andaman a few times in the last few months and every time they have been outstanding! The Nurses and Doctors really listen to you and provide the best possible advice and treatment. Very kind and professional amd very reasonably priced.
Pretty shitty clinic had me waiting for hella hour just to take a shot and I didn’t even get a shot from them cause I do t want to wait any longer worst experience ever

Brilliant clinic went here yesterday got seen by the doctor very quickly was having trouble with my colitis causing fever headaches had strep throat infection also got injection and antibiotics and I'm feeling 100% this morning
Very good Doctor and very nice person. Recommend if needed. He picked up what I had very quickly and sharply. Totally affordable

It's unfortunate that I'm forced to give this guy 1 star he has a bad attitude and only interested in money he is expensive compared to a real hospital and I would advise anyone to go to a real hospital
2nd time we've been to this doctor. Very professional and knowledgeable. Diagnosed my issue quickly. Very affordable too!
Excellent clinic! competent a doctor and good staff. Everything is excellent as always
It is rare to find a doctor as unkind as the one who runs this clinic. Better choose other clincs over this one.
Very nice doctor and nurses, taking care of me very well
Doctor was clear, correctly diagnosed my son's illness, spoke clear English, and gave the prescription on site. Would go back again.

A very good doctor.

I had several head injuries that required stitches at the hospital; these needed to be cleaned, and I had that done at this clinic.

Very good service.
Good service, affordable prices.

Yesterday, I went to see the doctor with symptoms of headache, body aches, fever, and tonsillitis, which prevented me from eating. The doctor prescribed two medications and gave me an injection. After that, I went home and rested for three hours. When I woke up, my pain and fever were gone, and I was able to eat normally again. I am very impressed.

I don't recommend it.
The doctor, without even washing his hands, immediately got to work, touching my eye (I have a bump on my eyelid that hasn't gone away for two years) and saying that if it doesn't go away in two weeks, come back. It took two minutes, costing 300 baht.

Very friendly staff, very nice doctor, very short waiting times, very clean, English-speaking. I would recommend it to anyone who looks small

or has worse.

I was treated by Dr. Fee and can say that the medical care was outstanding. Even the staff was very friendly.

I can highly recommend the Health Care Clinic. The price was also absolutely justified.

Excellent doctor. He's straightforward and gets the job done.
Typical price around 1000 Baht including medication.

0 stars.

I absolutely do not recommend this place; don't go, it's a scam. He made two incorrect diagnoses. He insisted on giving us two injections (€60 per injection).

After a diagnosis at the hospital, they told us that the injections had nothing to do with the actual diagnosis.

Scam.

RUN AWAY, HE'S A CHARLATIST!
I came to this clinic from Hua Hin (650 km) for a cortisone injection recommended by my French doctor, as no other treatment has worked since April.
This injection was supposed to be administered by infiltration, and the syringe, which was ready to inject, only contained 1 ml of cortisone. However, I saw the assistant prepare an injection, filling it almost halfway, and then the doctor supposedly gave me the injection. It was done in less than 2 seconds, and I didn't even feel the slightest prick. Injecting that much product in 2 seconds is impossible. Furthermore, he didn't even disinfect with alcohol beforehand. And he should have injected it directly where I was experiencing pain.

And he charged me 50 euros for it.
Convenient and affordable.
I went there because I had a stomachache and was vomiting, and I was grateful that they treated me kindly even at night and even after closing time.
